newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen Kanko to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen Kanko to issue new shares.

text.p: Hotel operator Gajoen Kanko KK said on Thursday it would issue 35.78 million new shares to increase its total number to 92.36 million.
The firm said in a statement that 30.08 million new shares would be evenly allocated to existing shareholders and the remaining 5.70 million to six individuals.
Payment for the former would have to be made next February 4 and for the latter on January 23, it said.
The new share issue was planned to finance new projects and renovation of existing hotels, Gajoen said.
